findings.why_it_matters: A reader of the markdown Table 11 sees garbled group headings ("andsymbols Zero-suppression"); the precedence cells themselves are correct, so no rule changes, but the grouping labels should read as printed.
findings.pdf_says: Row-group labels (printed rotated) of Table 11: "Simple, special, and fixed insertion symbols", "Zero-suppression and floating insertion symbols", "Other symbols"
findings.note: The rotated row-group labels were transcribed word-reversed and, for the second group, scrambled into "floating andsymbols Zero-suppression insertion". Every 'x' cell of the 24-column table was compared cell by cell and matches the PDF; only the group labels are wrong.
